blindSpots: Cross-repo follow-ups are not found: only the merged PR's own repo is searched, so a follow-up filed in another repo (for example the repo of one of the PR's closing issues) is missed.

A candidate PR is stored with the state it had when its day settled (SETTLE_DAYS after the day's window closes), and that cache is never refreshed: a follow-up PR that was open then and later closed without merging still counts. Only deleting the day file re-reads it.
